  • Packaging
    • Applications
    • For Brands
    • Corrugated Packaging Solutions
    • Metal Packaging Solutions

    EFI™ Nozomi single-pass digital inkjet printers are the most efficient way to manufacture high-graphic packaging and the most effective way to create highly profitable business opportunities. EFI Nozomi printers produce image quality that competes with high-quality flexography and offset printing while providing a streamlined process. High value-added services, such as small or medium runs and variable data printing, can generate new sources of revenue and market opportunities, such as eCommerce and displays.

    Don’t overlook an opportunity to leverage your eCommerce packaging as a key marketing channel. Learn how you can enhance your brand, elevate your customer experience, and stay top of mind with the power of digital printing for corrugated eCommerce packaging.

    Shorter runs, rush orders, versioning, and last-minute changes are the new reality. EFI™ Nozomi LED Series single-pass corrugated packaging printers turn those challenges into opportunities—helping you streamline production, respond faster to customer demands, and keep your flexo and offset presses focused on the jobs they do best. It’s a smarter way to differentiate your business, win higher-margin work, and improve profitability.

    The metal packaging industry can now benefit from highly flexible, industrial digital inkjet printing with the advanced capabilities, efficiencies, and sustainable printing of the EFI™ Nozomi 12000 MP single-pass printer.

  • Textile
    • Applications
    • EFI Reggiani Digital Printers
    • EFI Reggiani Analog Printers
    • EFI Mezzera Pre- and Post-treatment Textile Machines
    • EFI Jaeggli Yarn Treatment Machines
    • Genuine EFI Textile Inks

    With over 75 years of innovation, research, and technological excellence, EFI™ Reggiani has become the trusted brand for integrated, scalable solutions for the entire textile process – from yarn treatment to fabric printing and finishing.

    EFI™ Reggiani digital printers deliver high-performance solutions that keep textiles and profits flowing, whether you’re operating a small manufacturing site or a large industrial plant. Our industry-leading scan and single-pass printers offer cutting-edge technology for a wide range of fabric and paper printing applications. With exceptional productivity, precise printing accuracy, superior quality, and efficient ink usage, EFI Reggiani printers provide the most competitive cost per foot available on the market.

    With an installed base surpassing 3,000 units, EFI™ Reggiani analog printers represent premium quality and reliability. With extended uptime, fast setup, and reduced water consumption, EFI Reggiani analog printers are top-performing machines delivering high efficiency and profitability.

    EFI™ Mezzera high-efficiency, textile treatment machines for preparation, washing, and dyeing lines improve the characteristics of finished garments.

    The EFI™ Jaeggli Extensa hank mercerizing machine for yarn treatment offers high operational flexibility, easy repetitiveness, and absolute evenness. Get consistent top results in the yarn’s final quality in terms of vibrancy, strength, dimensional stability, and dyeing affinity.

    Deliver the most brilliant shades on any textile application with a full range of certified, environmentally friendly, water-based inks.

  • Sign & Display
    • Applications
    • Roll-to-roll Printers
    • Flatbed Printers
    • Hybrid Flatbed/Roll-fed Printers
    • Super-high-speed Printers
    • Soft Signage Printers
    • Genuine EFI Inks and Armor Coatings

    EFI™ digital inkjet UV printers for the sign and display market have played an instrumental role in leading the analog-to-digital revolution. From the introduction of the first VUTEk® wide-format airbrush printer to the latest developments in LED UV curing technology, EFI wide- and superwide-format flatbed, hybrid, roll-to-roll, soft signage, and specialty printers continue to expand the possibilities of digital print.

    EFI™ superwide roll-to-roll LED printers offer the best in terms of performance, versatility, cost of ownership, usability, and environmental friendliness.

    EFI™ production-level, wide-format LED flatbed printers are ideal for printing on sheets of flexible or rigid materials, irregularly shaped or heavy objects, or materials with uneven surfaces, which are held securely to the table with a vacuum system throughout the printing process.

    EFI™ production-level, digital inkjet hybrid flatbed/roll-fed LED printers offer the ultimate flexibility with the ability to print roll-to-roll, flexible sheets, and rigid substrates in a single footprint. With a fast changeover from flexible to rigid materials, EFI hybrid LED UV printers offer cost-effective production and are perfect if you want to offer a wide variety of sign and display graphics applications.

    Shift your capabilities, productivity, and profit margins into overdrive with EFI™ super-high-speed industrial inkjet printers for ultra-high volume producers of sign and display graphics.

    EFI™ production-level, dye-sublimation printers produce beautiful, digitally printed fabrics, soft signage, banners, flags, and other custom applications faster and more efficiently with inline fixation or a one-step transfer process.

    Genuine EFI™ Inks and Armor Coatings are custom-formulated for every EFI sign and display inkjet printing system. With EFI UV inks and coatings, you get the highest color quality, durability, performance, reliability, consistency, and predictable running costs.

  • Industrial Printing
    • Applications
    • Ceramics
    • EFI Rialco Industrial Ink Products

    EFI™ Cretaprint®  digital inkjet printers are robust, industrial printing systems for the decoration of ceramics.

    EFI™ Cretaprint® inkjet printers are the most advanced digital ceramic decorating systems. With the printer, Genuine EFI Cretacolor Inks, and Fiery® color management system working as one, EFI is the only company in the industry that supplies a total solution to help your business maximize your digital printing success.

    EFI™ Rialco industrial ink products include formulated color systems for the timber preservation sector, and dye powders and other components for the ink sector.

What we do

EFI™ is a technology company, with offices, R&D, and manufacturing locations worldwide, leading the transformation from analog to digital imaging. We develop breakthrough technologies for manufacturing packaging, sign and display graphics, and textiles with digital inkjet printers, inks, and software.

Encouraging employee health and happiness

  • Work-life balance: Our flexible time off plans encourage team members to take time off so they can recharge and come back refreshed. And we offer remote and hybrid work schedules (for qualified positions) so you can keep on living that flexible lifestyle.
  • Open communication: We’re dedicated to ensuring all employees have the information they need to do their jobs well. We strive to bring our offices together through multiple avenues of communication. And on a quarterly basis, our senior leadership team hosts an update meeting for all employees. At the end of the update, employees are encouraged to ask questions and voice their opinions or concerns directly to the executives.
  • We give back: Whether you are at an office location or working remotely, you are part of a global organization that takes its social responsibility seriously. We are always looking for ways to give back to those in need and encourage our employees to volunteer.
  • We value our employees: We’re serious about rewarding our employees for their contributions to the business through recognition and compensation programs.
  • We encourage fun: One benefit of having amazing coworkers is enjoying each other’s company, so we make it a point to create fun activities for our employees. We believe in working hard and playing hard!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

As a global organization, we believe the diversity of our employees, clients, products, and operations is what distinguishes EFI. As part of our winning strategy, EFI is committed to nurturing an environment where diversity, equity, and inclusion are the core of who we are. We work together to ensure all individuals’ voices are respected and heard. EFI’s goal is to attract and retain a talented and diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities in which we operate and ensure all employees are treated equally irrespective of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, ethnicity or national origin, disability, pregnancy, religion, political affiliation, union membership, covered veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status in our hiring and employment practices.
